guide.text: No purchase order or material request in ERPNext names the sales order it is for, so what covers each order is inferred from the items and dates. Raise them from the sales order and the link is exact:
steps: Open the Sales Order that needs goods you do not hold.
Click Create, then Purchase Order (choose the supplier; tick the items to buy) -- or Create, then Material Request, for buying to order it.
Check the quantities and the Required By date, save and submit it. Each line now carries the sales order it is for.
A Purchase Order made from that Material Request (Create, Purchase Order) keeps the link.
Receive and bill against that Purchase Order as usual; this platform follows it from order to receipt to invoice.
guide.label: Open the Sales Orders

Check the quantities and the Required By date, save and submit it. Each line now carries the sales order it is for.
A Purchase Order made from that Material Request (Create, Purchase Order) keeps the link.
Receive and bill against that Purchase Order as usual; this platform follows it from order to receipt to invoice.
